author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-03-17 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Have faith in your imaginal act.
context_before: Believe in the reality of your own imaginal acts, for faith is loyalty to unseen reality.
context_after: Although unseen by the outer world as an external fact, your loyalty to its unseen reality will cause the unseen to become seen by the world. This is the practical side of this night. You and I can lift the cross from our own shoulders; for as I lift your cross I am lifting mine, and in a way I do not know the burden is lifted from me. Everyone you meet is yourself made visible, for there is nothing but yourself in the world.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Bear Ye One Another’S Burdens (1969-03-17).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-03-17 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then you will no longer see scripture as secular history.
context_before: When scripture unfolds within you, you will know a thrill that is beyond ecstasy.
context_after: You will know from experience that the story is supernatural, and has nothing to do with history as we understand it. The events spoken of by the apostles did not take place on earth, but in the soul of man as he walks the earth.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Bear Ye One Another’S Burdens (1969-03-17).
